title: The Ledger
text: Under the ice of Vess (a moon of Halcyon). Meridian's record of every run: twelve columns, one per run, each a planet-health score for the three probes. Eleven columns end with the same line in Accord's own log format: "purge complete, run closed." The twelfth is open. Reading it (ledger-read) is needed for Engram to defect and for the Proof ending.
